rc5_blockers.reported_against: 2.0.0rc4; the fail-open branch is at crates/risk/src/engine/mod.rs:1218-1234 at tag v2.0.0rc5
rc5_blockers.effect: For a broker-routed SMART instrument the account registered under venue IB is not found, so every account-scoped pre-trade check (max_notional_per_order, free balance, cumulative notional) is skipped with only a debug log.
rc5_blockers.upstream_fix: Closed 2026-09-25T11:03:11Z by develop commit ed6fc8bf47fd37dda97d63b9b2df160719ee2bac ('Apply pre-trade risk to the destination execution account'), which is in no release (the newest release is the prerelease v2.0.0rc5; GitHub's releases/latest is v1.231.0; read 2026-10-01); PR #5041 also lists it as covered.

rc5_reclassified_reports.reported_effect: The execution client venue IB never matches the SMART instrument venue, so every stock order is denied locally.
rc5_reclassified_reports.basis: Source reading, not an rc5 order observation: at tag v2.0.0rc5 (1b0a49d2) crates/execution/src/engine/mod.rs:2222 denies an order only when client.handles_order_venue(order_venue) is false, and the IB execution client overrides it to return true (crates/adapters/interactive_brokers/src/execution/core.rs:491-496). First recorded in PR #280 on 2026-09-25 and in the 2026-09-26 trading convergence record (PR #358).
